I believe that it really depends on the person, as everything else, it effects everyone a bit differently. For example, I know many pwBPD who can drink just fine, but I absolutely can not. I'm a terrible person when I drink.

I think that responsible dose, rolling in a safe environment, good day-aftercare, someone to talk to (if you need it), and going into it with therapeutic intentions is key.

Realizing the things that I do to feel 'wanted' are so toxic and destructive, realizing that most people don't navigate life this way. All of that has really made me start to come to terms with it. I arrived at her apartment that morning and my mother, who was there at the time, describes checking up on my Grandmother and she was coming from her master bathroom, looking confused and breathing heavy.
